origin.description: Which scope the value came from. The cascade is session → agent → project → workspace, and exposing the ORIGIN is what lets the UI say "inherited from the project" instead of showing a value with no provenance.

skipped.description: More specific scopes the cascade discarded before reaching `origin`. Empty on the normal path.

reason.description: `unavailable`: the model vanished from the provider catalog. `sem_tool_calling`: the request is from an agent and the model is chat-only — the cascade revalidates the capability at every level so as not to silently violate RN-040.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
